title: Surreal Upside-Down Figure
description: A surreal black and white line drawing depicts a large upside-down humanoid figure with multiple eyes, geometric shapes, and mechanical elements floating against a black background. The lower portion shows a vast field of purple lavender with small white silhouetted figures, while the central oval face has three eyes and holds two ornate staffs.
prompt: Surreal black and white illustration of an upside-down humanoid figure composed of multiple floating eyes, geometric shapes, skulls, and mechanical parts against a solid black background. The figure has long limbs and holds two ornate staffs. Below is a vast lavender field with rows of purple flowers and tiny white human silhouettes walking. A large central oval mask-like face with three eyes sits in the middle. Red circular accents and floating papers with text appear near the top.
